size_is: weapon box area as a share of the image the model is given, which in the OCU is the crop around a detected person, not the whole frame
stage: second stage on a person: the person detector finds someone, the frame is cropped to their box and enlarged, and this model runs on the crop

handgun.source: Open Images photographs, 98 test images by photographers absent from training (decision 48, arm B)

long_gun.source: Open Images photographs, 98 test images by photographers absent from training (decision 48, arm B)

false_alarms.source: photographs of a person holding a bat, racket, phone, camera, tripod or instrument and no gun; every false alarm was looked at by eye and none was a gun (decision 48)

caveats: measured on web photographs of guns, not on a rover's camera: a crop from a camera 20 m away, enlarged, is blurrier than a photograph, so these recalls are an upper bound
handgun rests on a few dozen boxes, so its curve is wide; the intervals are in the bins
a control trained on randomly placed boxes still scored 0.26 to 0.44 AP50 on this data (decision 47), so a share of the apparent skill is recognising a gun photograph rather than locating the gun
nothing was measured at night, in thermal, from the air, or on a gun that is not being carried in the open
